Evidence boundary

This report distinguishes screens captured here from system surfaces that require physical-device or account evidence.

Verified here: Mac window remained exactly 1100×800 before and after identifier-based selection of empty Now Playing. Mac screenshots came from the signed candidate build; iPhone screenshots were freshly recorded by 8 passing XCUITests. Not claimed: Lock Screen, Control Center, external audio routing, production CloudKit round trips, Apple sign-in or permission sheets. The app does not enter a custom permission sheet in these fixtures; those system-owned surfaces still require attended device/account evidence.
